_about: Named systems/pages the knowledge base mentions in prose, mapped to the OFFICIAL URL the Graduate School itself links them to. The chatbot turns the first mention in an answer into a clickable link. Nothing here is guessed: each url was read from the site menu page named in 'seen_on' (label = the site's own link text). A system with no student-facing official link (e.g. Turnitin) is deliberately absent. Re-verify with tests/linkify.test.mjs --online.
